own_solution.law: Vertical balance gives N = mg. Static friction supplies the centripetal force: mv²/r ≤ μsN. Hence vmax = sqrt(μsgr) = sqrt(0.6 × 9.8 × 50).
assumptions: The car follows the stated circular trajectory at steady speed.
The standard particle model applies, with tyre-road static friction supplying the horizontal centripetal force.
